note: Written by scripts/capture.mjs. Emulator recordings of the real app.

unlock.what: The Unlock screen: 'Buy it once. Keep it forever.' and the four ticks. The price button is cropped out — the product is not in Play yet, so it spins.

style.what: The style sheet: nine presets animating the user's own line, the scroll to the last three, the hue strip dragged, yellow picked back

dictionary.what: A word's sheet, 'Add to your words', the dictionary with the entry half written, Save, back in the editor

saving.what: Export → Save to gallery → the render, about thirty seconds on this emulator → Saved, with the share buttons

pick.what: Airplane mode on. Home → New video → the system picker → the curtain → Processing with the words arriving → the editor

toggle.what: The quick-settings shade pulled down over Home and the Airplane mode tile tapped. The physical action, on camera.

saved.what: The Saved screen: the tick, the filename, Share, and the one-time feedback card. No setup on purpose — it records whatever is on screen, and it is meant to be run right after the `saving` shot's export has actually finished, which on this emulator is 54 s, longer than that shot records.

export.what: A real Wordburn export. Captions burned in by the app's own module, not redrawn here.
